source_checks.finding: Tasnim reports Monday reopening of Khosravi after the Thursday suspension at Iraq’s request during the Baghdad curfew. The article identifies Iranian pilgrims and the Kermanshah route.
Logistics Cluster identifies Khosravi as Mundhiriya on the Iraqi side and the road via Khanaqin/Baquba to Baghdad, supporting the terminal identity.

date_scope_check.qualification_retained: R4-ME-001-R1: Restriction on departing pilgrims using the Baghdad route, not proof of a physically sealed gate. Anadolu’s October 6 Persian report is a same-day reopening announcement; its English report and Iran Press describe Sunday reopening. Tasnim and AFP/ISNA reporting describe Monday morning reopening, with the latter reporting that a group of pilgrims departed. Thus passage is documented by October 7, while the exact first resumption within October 6–7 and clock times remain uncertain. Chazzabeh reopened earlier according to Reuters and is excluded from this Khosravi interval, as are freight and reverse-direction movement.
